note: N-179 (N-038 / F-348): bump() is @sighash SINGLE|FORKID, so the SDK signs the call under 0x43 and the on-chain OP_PUSH_TX binding re-derives the sighash under 0x43; the continuation commits only output 0 (no change segment, no _changePKH/_changeAmount params). The harness funds each call from a separate P2PKH UTXO, so every call tx carries a change output the SINGLE covenant does not commit. reset() keeps ALL|FORKID.
